title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {n p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (p ∣ n.factorial ↔ p ≤ n)
